segment.description: Little Chuckey Creek (also spelled Little Chucky Creek), a major Greene County agricultural tributary of the Nolichucky River (HUC 06010108). Identity verified by county and HUC before citing: TDEC's 2026 303(d) list carries 'Little Chucky Creek, Greene County, RIVER, 21.9 Miles' in Nolichucky assessment unit TN06010108034; the catalog carries GNIS 01326826. Same-name creeks elsewhere were screened out.
segment.boundaries: Entire Greene County creek (21.9 mi assessed length in TDEC's 2026 303(d) list); catalog gives no sub-reach boundaries.

coldSource.notes: No cold-water source of any kind documented. TDEC's 2026 303(d) list records the creek as E. coli-impaired with the cause 'GRAZING IN RIPARIAN OR SHORELINE ZONES' — a documented agricultural-grazing valley creek, the opposite of a coldwater profile. No canopy/gorge/elevation statements found in any agency source retrieved.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation exists or is expected for a creek with no trout program and no trout record; nothing found.

wildPopulation.detail: No trout presence of any kind documented. The creek is absent from TWRA's 2026 trout stocking schedule (live JSON feed searched for 'Chuckey' and 'Chucky', zero rows, fetched 2026-09-18), absent from TWRA's wild trout stream list on the trout regulations page, and absent from the STMP. The only agency fish/water record retrieved is the TDEC 303(d) agricultural impairment.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: No trout program, no trout record, and no wild-trout listing anywhere in agency sources, while TDEC's 2026 303(d) list documents 21.9 miles of Little Chucky Creek (Greene County) E. coli-impaired from riparian grazing — an agricultural warmwater creek with no documented cold-water source.
